crossRefs.note: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
crossRefs.keyword: What meanest thou by all this drove? Heb. What is all thisband to thee?

crossRefs.note: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor…
From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for…
The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the…

translations.web: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
translations.bsb: “What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau. “To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
translations.kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
translations.asv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this company which I met? And he said, To find favor in the sight of my lord.
